title: M.C. Vijayanandha Reddy (VNR) – YSRCP Leader, Jananeta, Chittoor Assembly
description: Official profile of M.C. Vijayanandha Reddy (VNR), YSRCP MLA Candidate for Chittoor Assembly. Former APSRTC Vice Chairman, Jananeta (People's Leader), philanthropist, and close ally of Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy. Known for Jagananna Canteens, COVID relief, and community service in Chittoor.
